A poem for you

Everything I see when I look at you, written the only way I know how: in orbits.

Rian, in Orbit
a poem for you

Some people are beautiful the way the moon is,quiet, and a little unreal,until you notice the whole sea leaning toward them.That is you.

Your smile is a small sunrisethat never asks the dark for permission.Your laugh bends the room around it,and everything I thought was fixedlearns to move in your direction.

They say the planets never touch the sun.They only find the exact distancewhere it’s warm enough to stay alive.I spent a long time finding mine,circling, careful, an orbitterpretending I was only passing by.

Then you looked back,and what was only gravitybecame a name.

You are the reason my sky has a center.You are the light I keep my whole orbit by.And if I could choose any path across the dark,I would choose the long, looping, ordinary onethat always, always comes back to you.

— Jilean

A message in a bottle

It drifted a long way just to find you. Tap the glowing cork.

tap the cork

Dear Rian,

If you’re reading this, it means my little bottle found its way to you.

I wrote it on the night I realized something simple: of all the shores in the world, I’d want every wave to bring me to you.

Thank you for the first month. For the laughs, for the quiet, and for every ordinary day that felt special because you were in it.

Here’s to many more months, and to a bottle that never runs out of words.

Always yours, Jil

One last thing

I’m not ready for a big ring yet. My life is still taking shape, and I won’t pretend it’s finished. So this is a promise ring: a small circle with a big promise inside. I promise I will never leave you. Not on the loud days, not on the quiet ones, and not on the days I don’t deserve you. I promise to keep choosing you, and to keep working toward the life we both want. One day this ring will have a bigger sibling. Until then, will you keep this one?

For Rian, with all my love.

Happy 1st monthsary, Rian.
